name: Spectral Scythe summons one scythe per Reaped Soul and the scythes attack with Scythe Sweep (#10823, #11114)
contract: Spectral Scythe 500484: 'Summons 1 Spectral Scythe for each Reaped Soul active'. Its summon effect value is 1
(SummonProperties 61), so the core summoned one scythe for any soul count; a live Domination Reaper's log
(2026-08-04) shows 3, 1, 1, 3, 3 ... summons per cast, one per Reaped Soul 500363 stack.
Scythe Sweep 500489 is the scythe's next-swing attack (SPELL_ATTR0_ON_NEXT_SWING_NO_DAMAGE): live scythes cast
it 385 times against 10 plain swings. Creature 250305 had no AI that queues it, so no Scythe Sweep landed.
